name: Jumby Bay Island Resort
positioning: Fully inclusive, car-free private island resort off Antigua's north coast, managed by Oetker Collection as Jumby Bay Island
best_for: Travelers who want a fully inclusive stay on a car-free island
Families, with a kids club and villas offering butler service
Guests keen on watersports, tennis and pickleball

facts.text: Accommodation on Jumby Bay Island comes as private estates, villas and cottages.
The private estates are tended by devoted house staff.
The cottages are set above the sea.
Dining on the island spans three restaurants and four bars.
Heritage rum tastings are part of the dining program.
Jumby Bay Spa combines modern therapeutic practices with holistic treatments inspired by West Indies traditions.
The Racquet Club has two tennis courts, two pickleball courts and one basketball court.
Complimentary bicycles are available throughout the stay to explore the island.
A farm kitchen garden supplies the restaurants with fresh herbs and vegetables.
The Estate House serves afternoon tea and fine dining.
On Wednesdays a Caribbean-themed night is held along the beach.
In 2017 the homeowners' Jumby Bay Island Company appointed Oetker Collection to manage the hotel.

highlights.text: Jumby Bay is a 300-acre, car-free island off Antigua's north coast.
All beaches on the island are protected nesting areas for the endangered hawksbill turtle; Pasture Bay is a nesting site from June until November.
Jumby Bay Island offers a fully inclusive experience.
The villas come with dedicated butler service, and the Jumby Explorers Kids Club offers curated daily adventures tailored to every age group.
The 22 Knots watersports center covers sailing, waterskiing, paddleboarding and snorkel excursions.

considerations.text: The resort is on its own island: guests reach mainland Antigua by catamaran, a 15-minute ride, which is complimentary to and from the jetty at Winthrop's Bay for arrivals and departures.
The island is car-free, so guests get around by bicycle.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the ultra-luxury positioning.
